purpose: Read-only process analysis, with completed-task intersection for version comparisons; evaluation artifact only.

usage.local: python3 scripts/analyze_autonomous_process.py --run fixed50 formal_v3 /path/formal_v3 --run fixed50 progress_v4 /path/progress_v4 --output /outside/input/roots/process.json
usage.stdout: Pass --output - to execute the script through SSH stdin without deploying a file.
usage.validation_selection: --task task_001 --task task_002; both suites, both versions, all three ours methods when present

output_contract.conditions: Per-condition metrics, stage status, verified changed-file hashes, exact-read recurrence sources, feedback follow-through and source SHA256 ledger.
output_contract.summaries: Completed conditions and running/other incomplete conditions are separate descriptive summaries.
output_contract.paired_comparisons: Only common eligible completed task IDs; all unmatched or incomplete tasks are listed. No aggregate contrast of different completion subsets.
output_contract.definitions: The generated JSON embeds metric definitions and interpretation limits. No final acceptance or diagnosis is used to infer process actions.

verification.independent_check: Separate remote read counted request filenames and tool events, then checked byte-change records and event hashes; these counts were asserted against analyzer output.

interpretation: This small fixed-ID sample validates counting and provenance, not method effectiveness.
A feedback event followed by an action is an observed association; the script does not infer causality or diagnosis correctness.
A mixed successful edit changes production and scratch files in one operation and therefore contributes once to each edit category.
No running experiment, implementation, manifest or raw evidence was modified.

repair_stage_budget_assessment.recommendation: Worth one predeclared, complete 60-task development ablation against progress_v4 autonomous_layered_native, changing only repair_calls_per_stage from 8 to 32. Do not launch as part of this analysis.

retain.inputs_and_acceptance: same frozen inputs and suite-specific acceptance

repair_stage_budget_assessment.observed_mechanism: A production edit in the seventh action-capable repair round can be followed by a tool-disabled summary rather than a test. The next repair stage then resumes editing/testing. Existing repair history already persists across stages; the proposed change removes some forced summaries and external-submission boundaries, not a history reset.

budget_implications: With eight diagnosis calls and four full eight-call repair stages, up to four repair calls are reserved for summaries. A single full 32-call repair stage reserves one, permitting up to three additional action-capable model rounds within the same 40-call total.

Four external submissions remain a maximum, not four guaranteed 32-call episodes. If the first repair stage consumes all 32 remaining calls, later repairs have no model budget; early voluntary submission can leave budget for retries.

The current controller may record a zero-call budget-exhausted stage and perform its external evaluation after a previous stage consumed the remaining calls without returning a budget status. Preserve the recorded attempts and report zero-call stages separately; they are not extra model repair opportunities.

Because progress_loop emits at most one inspection checkpoint per stage, a long stage also has fewer possible reminders than four short stages. Record actual checkpoint counts and inspection streaks; do not silently introduce another policy change.

First-attempt acceptance has a different model-call allocation under this configuration. Primary comparison should use final acceptance under the common global budget, total calls/tokens/time, and calls before first accepted submission. Report submission-count curves with the stage allowance explicitly attached.
repair_stage_budget_assessment.limits: Recorded boundaries establish lost action slots and premature submission opportunities, not a counterfactual success rate. Keep all original tasks and outcomes; these tasks informed development and are not held-out evidence. No code or experiment was changed for this assessment.
